props.name: as
props.description: The element or component this component should render as. Can be overwritten by asChild.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Change the default rendered element for the one passed as a child, merging their props and behavior.

props.name: disabled
props.description: When true, prevents the user from interacting with the item.

props.name: hasChildren
props.description: Whether the item should display a disclosure indicator. Defaults to the tree data.

props.name: icon
props.description: Iconify icon rendered before the item text.

props.name: text
props.description: Text rendered when no text or default slot is provided.

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: Iconify icon rendered at the end of the row.
